L1.label: Concepts and conventions
L1.criterion: Identify definitions, objects, units, quantifiers or a directly supplied graph relation.

L2.label: Local derivation
L2.criterion: Execute one mathematical mechanism with explicit hypotheses, or combine a few supplied structural facts.

L3.label: Multi-step proof and diagnosis
L3.criterion: Coordinate several estimates, separate cases, exhibit a counterexample or diagnose an invalid inference.

L4.label: Cross-module composition
L4.criterion: Compose results with real assumption adapters, measurable/integrable inputs and error/constant tracking.

L5.label: Research-level audit and transfer
L5.criterion: Audit a source-grounded research argument or transport a proof mechanism while exposing unresolved interfaces and failure boundaries. No unsolved conjecture may be scored against an invented gold proof.

difficulty_policy: Author-assigned, track-specific provisional labels; empirical calibration is pending. Token count, code length, import depth and graph distance are not difficulty scores.
coverage_policy: Track counts are separate. A shared item may appear in several domain indexes, but counts once globally. Empty cells are gaps, not automatically generated filler or proof-completion percentages.
graph_policy: Current graph QA uses a bounded, source-hashed module-import slice made only from the listed project-original files. Imports are syntactic availability, not theorem implication, mathematical necessity or conceptual equivalence. Elaborated theorem DAG, source-proof and conceptual-hypergraph tasks need separate reviewed evidence before admission.
